properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-05 (0.76.0, 0.78.0, main): 0.78.0's `blocked` covers a test collection error. A check recorded `blocked` raises blocked_verification ("could not run … not that it works, and not that it fails"); on 0.76.0 it raised nothing. But the two tools an agent uses to record a check by hand, add_verification and set_verification_status, list `blocked` without saying what it means. Only reconcile_verification's outcome and the schema say "a collection error"
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-05, triaging art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05, entry [gap] of 2026-10-01: "a Verification recording pytest exit 2 during import collection (no test body ran) produced `failing_verification` prose saying its capability and component 'did not work as designed then' … suggest distinguishing blocked collection from failed assertions." The reporter recorded the check by hand, through add_verification. This is the same report as tool friction 3 of art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02, root-caused in the subject finding. 0.78.0 shipped its fix (#662, chg:a-check-that-could-not-run-lands-as-blocked-and-never-reads-as-failed-2026-10-03).

⑤ MEASURED, `--call` on scratch stores. Two capabilities, two checks with the same collection-error description, one `failing` and one `blocked`, then detect_gaps.
- 0.76.0: `failing` gives "… so 'Queue runs plans' did not work as designed then". `blocked` gives NO gap at all.
- 0.78.0 and main: `failing` gives the same sentence, which is correct for a check that ran and failed. `blocked` gives "could not run, so it says nothing about whether 'Queue pauses plans' works: not that it works, and not that it fails".
So the gap is covered when the check is recorded `blocked`.

WHAT IS STILL MISSING, on the reporter's route. The agent records a check by hand and reads the tool's parameters to choose a status. On main, `--describe add_verification` (the door's new way to read a tool) gives `status`: "`planned` / `passing` / `failing` / `skipped` / `blocked` — for the common case 'I just ran it and here is what it found'. Omit it and the check lands `planned`." set_verification_status gives the bare list. Neither says that a collection or import error is `blocked`. Over every served tool on main, the only text tying `blocked` to a collection error is reconcile_verification's `outcome` description. The automated route (tools/run_to_files.py) maps it by itself. describe_schema on Verification would serve the schema's description, but only to an agent that thinks to ask.

⑥ CLASS: the meaning of an enum value is written in the schema and copied by hand into tool descriptions, and here the copy was made on one route (the reconcile) and not the other two. It is the hand-maintained-list shape the skill names. A fix at the class would derive a typed status parameter's description from the schema's.

⑦ NOT DONE (triage only): the pinning test. Every enum value the schema describes appears with that description in each typed parameter that takes it.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the reporter's agent would have chosen `blocked` from the bare list.
